model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for various per-specialty medical terms across different fine-tuning conditions of the Mistralv0.2-Base model. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists six categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, arranged in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -22 to -27, with tick marks at regular intervals of one unit. For each specialty term, there are seven grouped bars representing the model’s performance under seven different fine-tuning conditions: Cardio (light peach), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), Pediatrics (dark brown), and Mistralv0.2-Base (light blue). The Mistralv0.2-Base bar is consistently the tallest (least negative) for each specialty term, indicating the highest probability value, while the Pediatrics bar is consistently the shortest (most negative) for each specialty term, indicating the lowest probability value. The bars are sorted by specialty term in alphabetical order, and no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color coding and grouping.
